schedule.basis: 90 days after the last day the lien could have been preserved; ONLY if the lien was actually preserved first (s.36(1)); a preserved lien may instead be perfected by sheltering under another claimant's action (s.36(4))

schedule.label: publish notice of termination by
schedule.basis: owner or contractor must publish a notice of termination within 7 days; the termination date for s.31 is the date the first notice is published
